entry.title: New: dsh-daemon
entry.summary: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update). Exact install spec: @chenkai114/dsh-daemon. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
